title: Sugary Drink Labeling Study
summary: This study aims to examine the effects of added sugar warning labels on sugary drinks. Participants will be assigned to view either added sugar warning labels or control labels, applied on sugary drinks in an experimental store. Participants will shop for beverages in the store and take a computer survey at 4 visits spaced approximately 1 week apart.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years and older
* Bought sugary drinks from a store at least once during the past week
* Willing to attend 4 in-person study appointments

Exclusion Criteria:

* Living in the same household as someone else in the study
sponsor: University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill
